descriptions.sol29c_record_fill_insert_8034d1c8: Inserts n copies of an opaque 12-byte record before a position in a vector. With spare capacity, saves the input value, constructs shifted tail records, copies backward and assigns the gap; otherwise allocates old size plus max(old size,n), constructs head, inserted values and tail, destroys and frees the old block, and updates begin, finish and storage end.
